description: Hi! I'm a 3rd-year B.Tech IT student passionate about AI, machine learning, and full-stack development. I've built AI-powered applications and worked with Python, FastAPI, React, APIs, and ML models. I'm especially looking for team members skilled in AI/ML, frontend/backend development, data analysis, and creative problem-solving.
